posts.title: Sometimes you just need to write something down
posts.description: After a few months of effort (and even more months idly thinking about it), I finally released Tempy , my latest app. Tempy is a quick notes app. A digital scrap of paper that is always handy. And it’s an app that I’ve been wanting for myself for a long time. The brief An experience focused on quick capture An editor that makes both writing and reading enjoyable Easy ways to get text out of the ap

posts.title: How a popup made me ban (most of) big tech from my life
posts.description: It started with Dropbox. I have been a customer for a couple of years, paying their highest individual tier price because I needed two things: reliable syncing and lots of storage. This should have been a win-win situation. Dropbox was offering a product that fit my needs and I was willing to pay the price they asked. But then at some point, I started getting increasingly obnoxious upsell messages

posts.title: DoRepeat 2.0
